name: The Bounty of Teldrassil
summary: Nessa Shadowsong is comparing Teldrassil's fish with the mainland catch. She sends samples from Rut'theran Village to Auberdine to learn whether the island fish are larger and more plentiful.

sections.title: A Fisherman's Study
sections.body: Nessa Shadowsong asks you to carry fish bones and scales to Laird in Auberdine. Fishers in Rut'theran Village bring in large, plentiful catches. Nessa wants to learn whether the mainland waters yield the same kind of fish. The samples let Laird compare the island catch with fish from the coast of Darkshore.

sections.title: Arranging Passage
sections.body: Nessa Shadowsong sends you to Vesprystus, the hippogryph master in Rut'theran Village, with the collection for Auberdine. Give him the samples, and he arranges your passage across the water to Darkshore.

faq.q: What is Nessa trying to investigate?
faq.answer: Nessa Shadowsong wants to compare the large, plentiful fish caught around Rut'theran Village with fish from the mainland coast of Darkshore. She sends bones and scales for Laird to compare.

faq.q: Who is receiving the fish samples in Auberdine?
faq.answer: Laird, a fish vendor in Auberdine, receives the collection from Nessa Shadowsong.

faq.q: Why take the parcel to Vesprystus instead of traveling directly to Auberdine?
faq.answer: Vesprystus is the hippogryph master in Rut'theran Village. Nessa sends you to him with the collection so he can arrange passage across the water to Darkshore.

faq.q: Where is Rut'theran Village located in relation to Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Rut'theran Village sits at the southern base of Teldrassil, at sea level. An emerald portal connects it to Darnassus, and its harbor serves ships and hippogryphs traveling to and from the great tree.

faq.q: What happens after giving the collection to Vesprystus?
faq.answer: After Vesprystus accepts the collection, he offers Flight to Auberdine. A hippogryph carries you across the strait to Darkshore.

faq.q: Is this part of leaving the starting zone for Night Elves?
faq.answer: Yes. This chain introduces young night elf adventurers to flight paths and guides them from Teldrassil to Darkshore, where they continue their journeys.

angles.text: For night elf travelers, the journey leads from the heights of Teldrassil to the mainland shores of Darkshore.
For the Alliance, the route between Rut'theran and Auberdine links the night elf capital with the rest of northern Kalimdor.
